vectors.description: Validates restored accounts trim names, preserve IDs, apply null fee overrides to shared defaults, and apply explicit per-account fee overrides.
Rejects restored account lists with id <= 0, blank name, duplicate IDs, negative/NaN feeDiscount, or negative minFeeRegular.
Resolves activeAccountId after account restore, keeping existing IDs or 0 and resetting deleted IDs to 0.
Serializes Account with fee overrides and deserializes legacy JSON lacking feeDiscount/minFee fields as null.
TransactionListRepository scopes queries by activeAccountId (specific account vs 0 for all accounts) and sets isLoaded=true after emission.
TransactionListRepository treats empty Room results as loaded and propagates subsequent inserts and deletions.
orderedTransactionsByStock groups by market:code, sorts stably by (date, recordTime, id) ASC, reuses the exact map reference on price-only updates, and rebuilds on transaction updates.
Enforces TW/US market boundaries for cache keys, ticker inference (mixed alphanumeric stays TW), and margin repayment lot matching across markets.
SettingsDataStore recovers safely from malformed JSON caches, defaults P&L toggles to false, starts update highlights version as null, and persists auto backup error/attempt timestamps.
TextSizeMode.normalize falls back to DEFAULT for null/empty/unknown values, and scale maps modes to exact float density multipliers.
Ordinary buy, partial sell, and dividend replay totals at valuationDate = 3L
validateLongPositionBalances rejects selling more shares than held at transaction time
validateLongPositionBalances rejects capital reduction when sharesAfterReduction mismatches capitalReductionRatio
Financed open position uses remaining cash investment rather than full cost basis
Moving-average partial sale splits realized/unrealized P&L and cost while preserving legacyTotalProfitLoss
Loss capital reduction without cashReturned keeps total cost intact, raises unrealizedAverageCost, and creates no realized loss
Partial short cover allocates opening income, cover expense, and accrued borrow fee proportionally while preserving legacy total P&L
XIRR computes annual rate using calendar days in zoneId across leap year and DST transitions
Stock dividend share calculation divides by 10.0 par value for TW and uses direct shares-per-share for US
Taiwan minimum sell fee distinguishes 1000-share regular lots from odd lots
replayCutoffMillis returns exact end-of-day across a 23-hour spring-forward DST date in America/New_York
validateForWrite rejects ordinary buy with sell or short fields while permitting legacy fee on split
Margin daily simple interest accrues from purchase day inclusive and excludes repayment day (3 days on 80,000 at 36.5% / 365 = 240.0).
Partial margin principal repayment with actual broker interest replaces only the proportional accrued interest (40,000 / 100,000 = 40% settled; 60% of 1,000 = 600.0 remains accrued).
Interest-only margin payment (marginRepayment=0, marginActualInterest=1050) settles all accrued interest up to the payment date while leaving principal untouched.
Explicit manual zero self-funded override (marginSelfFunded=0.0, marginSelfFundedOverridden=true) is preserved instead of falling back to expense - principal.
Inserting a backdated repayment when a later repayment already exhausts the lot fails hasValidRepaymentBalances.
Short cover reduces only the selected lot and accrues borrow fee on 100,000 for 10 days (100.0) plus 60,000 for 10 days (60.0) = 160.0.
Stock split (10x) scales open short lot original and remaining shares so a 10,000-share cover is valid only when split is present.
Fully covered 1-year short with 100,000 principal, 90,000 cover expense, and 3.65% borrow fee deducts -3,650 accrued fee from terminal XIRR cash flow, yielding 6.35% XIRR.
Repayment expense must equal marginRepayment + marginActualInterest and short compensation expense must equal shortCompensation.
Financing market validation rejects US-shaped ticker 'AAPL' even if market argument is 'TW', and accepts TW ticker '2330' in 'TW'.
New candidate transaction with id=0 and equal (date, recordTime) is assigned a provisional ID > maxExistingId so it validates after the existing opening lot.
Lot selection when editing an intermediate transaction excludes the edited transaction and all later transactions by (date, recordTime, id) so full remaining principal is visible.
Collects buy, dividend, and sell cash flows incrementally as valuationDate advances without mutating earlier prefixes.
Applies transactionDateMapper to emitted CashFlow date while evaluating inclusion against raw transaction.date <= valuationDate.
Includes dividend via legacy income fallback when dividendIncome=0.0 and includeDividendIncome=true, and omits it when includeDividendIncome=false.
Incremental advanceTo matches full replay across unordered transactions including buy, dividend, 2x split, sell, and 10% capital reduction with cash return.
Isolates 2x split and 10% capital reduction to accountId=1 without modifying accountId=2 shares.
Resolves home XIRR zones (TW=Asia/Taipei, US=America/New_York, COMBINED=UTC), market close end millis (TW 13:30, US 16:00), and rejects invalid date 2026-02-30.
Checks month-span history coverage (passes 1M, fails 6M for 2026-07 to 2026-08) and returns null instead of 0.0 when priceAtOrBefore has no earlier point.
Computes daily P&L and return %, ignores zero previous portfolio base for return %, anchors month-start P&L to previous trading day, and compounds monthly returns.

StockHistoryCache rejects stale generation writes after clear(), current-month cache requires finite price at latestExpectedHistoryDate (skipping weekends and pre-close days), and manual refresh bypasses current month only.
Expanding 1M->6M->1Y reuses cached months in total step count, excludes unclosed current month before market close, and PortfolioHistoryProgressTracker aggregates out-of-order stocks monotonically.
Completed second TWSE batch and US single quote publish immediately while first TWSE batch is still blocked
Successful batch row becomes visible before missing-row fallback finishes, and failed fallback preserves existing cached quotes
Batches, US singles, and per-stock TW fallbacks share a 3-permit semaphore and propagate batch certificateFailure flag
Merging realtime stock info maps replaces updated keys, keeps unaffected keys, and returns a new map instance
targetHistoryMonths produces chronological YYYYMM strings anchored to market YearMonth
OTC TW stock queries TPEx tradingStock endpoint, converts ROC date 115/11/10 to 2026-11-10, and parses close price 1,085.00
Incomplete downloaded holiday calendar is rejected without saving and retries after 300,000ms cooldown
Bundled Taiwan calendar with higher calendarVersion replaces older saved snapshot and persists update
Taiwan stock list completeness enforces Listed(2), OTC(4), Emerging(5) order and rejects missing or empty sections

Verify transaction date sections aggregate daily cash-flow totals separately by market (TW before US) and recompute totals after search filtering.
